description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of records to produce a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, likely with Recharts. It organizes data by agent and an additional grouping dimension, filling in missing categories with zeros.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset with zero-filled categories for consistent visualization, grouping by agent and an optional secondary dimension.
